title: Propulsion Test Instrumentation and Data Analysis System — Overview and definition
t: Propulsion Test Instrumentation and Data Analysis System — Overview and definition
description: Synchronizes hot-fire measurements and computes performance metrics.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Synchronizes hot-fire measurements and computes performance metrics. A propulsion test system acquires pressures, temperatures, thrust, flow rates, and high-speed video during hot-fire tests, synchronizes them, and reduces performance (c*, Isp, efficiency). Real implementations are facility DAQ with custom reduction codes. It applies calibrations and uncertainty per test standards. Engineering test use only. Capability specification and design target: this database describes what the tool must do, not a claim of implementation or deployment.
